notes: Salim was present and reports the story; Ibn Umar's words to Hajjaj ("الرواح إن كنت تريد السنة") are the saying, so Ibn Umar is the last link (owner ruling 5). Hajjaj speaks in the scene and is not a link.
«كتب عبد الملك بن مروان» is inside Salim's story, not an opening, so the writer is not a link (rule 5).
